# DefaultPalette

`palette`

The single shared 256-entry palette for the character system. Characters store color indices; the shader samples this palette texture. One byte per index keeps network and persistence cost flat (§19).

> Define the controlled color space that preserves the pixel-art art direction

## Attributes

| Field | Type | Description |
| ----- | ---- | ----------- |
| entries | json | 256 hex color strings, region-grouped (§19) |
